basis: The attached four-page PRD; not the separate larger master specification described in older audit notes.

requirements.requirement: Find live hosts, open ports and services in scope
requirements.gap: Bounded discovery remains incomplete; planted-host/service denominator is unavailable.
requirements.acceptance: Run the selected tier against organiser ground truth; measure host/service recall and scope violations.

requirements.requirement: Crawl web apps, list endpoints and flag common issues
requirements.gap: Reviewed consolidated run contains Katana/ZAP fixtures; independent web-capability dispatch and current scope-policy consistency need validation.
requirements.acceptance: Produce real endpoints and reproducible findings with fixtures disabled; crawl-only policy must dispatch correctly.

requirements.status: core implemented; discovered-artifact extension in progress
requirements.gap: The reviewed consolidated report has no binary findings/evidence. Claude is changing acquisition, raw-byte provenance and no-fixture behaviour.
requirements.acceptance: Analyse a real supplied or authorised acquired artifact; retain hash/source/offset/method; qualify strings-only limitations; no authentication attempt.

requirements.requirement: Share findings and hand off work without repetition
requirements.gap: One-pass orchestration and task upserts lack atomic leases, stable artifact-based identity and restart proof; Probe application-view evidence is lost at adapter boundary.
requirements.acceptance: A duplicated/reordered web reference and a crash/restart produce exactly one eligible binary analysis and one durable result, preserving discovery provenance.

requirements.requirement: Map each step to a PTES phase
requirements.gap: 33 unmapped activities in reviewed report; producer operation fields mismatch mapper; triggered-binary tool executions omitted by PTES collector.
requirements.acceptance: Every executed step in one real end-to-end assessment maps to a justified phase; unmapped activities are zero or explicitly waived.

requirements.requirement: Verify findings rather than only flagging them
requirements.gap: Evidence ID existence is accepted without finding ownership; unrelated confirmed weaknesses can generate verified access transitions.
requirements.acceptance: Reject mismatched evidence; require direct, scoped request/response or static artifact proof; require separate transition evidence for access edges.

requirements.requirement: One report with attack path, simple API/page and README
requirements.gap: JSON includes path edges; PDF writer does not render an attack-path section. Newly triggered binary branch is not included in every reporting/provenance collector.
requirements.acceptance: One real run yields matching JSON/PDF/API output including asset/service inventory, findings, evidence-backed path, PTES events, limitations and fixture provenance.

validation: Read-only inspection plus three local pure-function reproductions; no network operations, assessments, binary execution or full test-suite run.
